svg.text: 1. Review Count Effect: No Balancing Method
Plain LR/XGBoost defaults; rows are unchanged.
Main question: balance emotion counts and compare F1.
Show the actual emotion counts after each balancing method.
Lower Count SD means better balance within the same training setup.
Balance each emotion as positive vs negative; SMOTE belongs in this group.
4.1 No balancing method: Binary-label results by emotion
Apply binary balancing methods when training and testing only on synthetic reviews.
Best LR count balance for YouTube + synthetic 784x6: hybrid (undersampling + oversampling), Count SD 98.5, LR F1 0.3483.
Best LR F1 among balancing methods: YouTube + synthetic 784x6 + undersampling, Macro F1 0.3901.
Best LR overall shown: YouTube + synthetic 784x3 + no balancing method, Macro F1 0.4131.
